verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report of a generous free tier: one user holds 300k embeddings at about 10% of the free capacity and sees no need to convert to paid. That suggests a meaningful free tier for prototyping, but nothing in the first-party docs describes the free plan, its limits, or whether a credit card is required. Another community comment says starter-account signups were temporarily unavailable due to demand, which is an availability caveat rather than evidence against the tier. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of free/starter plan limits, a no-credit-card signup, current and independent corroboration that the free tier is available.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: I'm still surprised by their generous free tier, I have a database of 300k embeddings on Pinecone and it's only 10% full by their metrics
